# orbstack Provider

Manage OrbStack Linux machines and Docker containers on macOS. Machines are created with orbctl. Containers are created on the OrbStack Docker engine, and create pulls the image.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    orbstack = {
      source = "machugram/orbstack"
    }
  }
}

provider "orbstack" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `docker_host` (String) Docker host URL. Defaults to the OrbStack socket.
- `orb_path` (String) Path to orbctl. Defaults to orbctl on PATH.
